scope: Only unattributed actual enemy HP damage divided by living participants is enabled in multiplayer scoring; personal quota witnesses retain exact dealer ownership.

featureBits.7: All three prototype features (rejected except shared damage)

protocol.search: Coordinator, Beam 12, 350 nodes, 3000 ms, DOP 1. Fixed budgets are not doubled.
protocol.externalEvaluation: Replay selected current-turn actions; then fixed local guard/power/ID order for up to 5 enemy cycles. Peer idle/one Defend/one Strike scripts run only in the evaluator, at the local end-turn boundary, and obey legality.
protocol.environment: Synthetic small decks and injected combat state; the evaluator and planner share the simulation engine. No repeated live-root capture or manual-advice closed loop after the first recommendation.
protocol.terminationInterpretation: Evaluation also stops on local death or action/cycle limits. won=false does not establish team defeat; truncated HP is not final battle loss.

horizon.evaluationProtocol: Selected current-turn cards, then one legal Strike per turn through cycle 14; teammates pass. Evaluation work is separate from search.
horizon.peerProtocol: Only peer_finisher: the teammate legally plays one Bludgeon before the first enemy cycle, then passes. This is a fixed perturbation, not a human probability model.

limitations: No live network or visible Steam performance evidence.
Intercept reference returns UnsupportedEffect; excluded from positive rescue conclusions.
Noxious Fumes and later setup fixtures still expose unresolved strategy gaps.
Low-HP guard-first sentinel preserves the opening, not full-fight survival under a fixed continuation script.
Original report race rate and ready inference were not implemented.
First-turn sensitivity under three fixed scripts is not an estimate of benefit with human partners or repeated manual replanning.
No observed prototype benefit in these narrow fixtures does not establish that peer-risk discounting or threat weighting is generally ineffective.
External HP metrics avoid the modified score but are not independent native-engine correctness evidence.
fixtureFailures: Lift fixture initially omitted an AnyPlayer target; corrected before dev-lift-fixed.
shared-ranking first launch used a CLI node limit below the settings minimum and never entered combat; rerun with CLI 100/internal 40 passed.
